title: Finite flat local base change with a separable lift of a smooth closed-fibre point
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and q:L\to\operatorname{Spec}A a smooth morphism [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let x be a closed point of its closed fibre [def-pc-fibre-product]. There are a Noetherian local ring A' and a flat local homomorphism \alpha:A\to A' [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] whose spectrum morphism is finite, and a point y of L\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}A' mapping to the image of x in L and to the closed point of A'. The residue-field map of the projection to \operatorname{Spec}A' at y is etale (a finite separable extension). No section or slice over A' is asserted.

proof.text: The smooth fibre is locally of finite type over the residue field. Choose an affine neighbourhood of its closed point x; the Nullstellensatz gives a finite residue extension K/k. Apply Tag 07NE at the maximal ideal of A: express K/k as a finite tower of simple extensions, lift each monic minimal polynomial coefficient to the preceding ring and form its monic polynomial quotient. The power basis gives finite freeness at each step and the residue quotient is the corresponding intermediate field.

The extended maximal ideal is maximal because the quotient is K. Finiteness makes the algebra integral, so every maximal ideal contracts to the maximal ideal of the local ring A; consequently all contain that extended maximal ideal and coincide with it. This supplies the local A', its local structural map, flatness by finite freeness, finiteness of the spectrum map and Noetherianity by module finiteness over A.

The equality of the residue quotient with K provides a K-valued point of Spec A'. Combine it with the canonical K-valued point of the original closed fibre at x in the pullback. The resulting rational point y lies over both x and the closed point of A'. Its residue field is the base residue field K, so the projection's residue-field map is an isomorphism and is etale. Polynomial quotients and this fibre product preserve universe u.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_closed_point_finite_flat_lift
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {L : Scheme.{u}} (q : L ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [Smooth q]
    (x : q.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set _)) :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : IsLocalRing A') (_ : IsNoetherianRing A'),
      ∃ (α : A →+* A'), IsLocalHom α ∧ α.Flat ∧
        IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α)) ∧
        ∃ y : (pullback q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α)) : Scheme.{u}),
          pullback.fst q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α)) y =
            q.fiberι (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) x ∧
          pullback.snd q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α)) y =
            IsLocalRing.closedPoint A' ∧
          ((pullback.snd q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α))).residueFieldMap y).hom.Etale
